remarks: Welcome to 664 Main Avenue #302, a bright and beautifully updated condo that perfectly blends comfort, convenience, and style. This spacious two-bedroom home features a newly updated kitchen with sleek cabinets, quartz counters, modern appliances, a new backsplash, and plenty of counter space to make meal prep a breeze. The open layout flows seamlessly into a comfortable living area, while the large primary bedroom offers room to unwind at the end of the day--with a fully updated bathroom. The second bedroom is set away from the first, creating optimal privacy or the option of an office. You'll also enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry and an elevator building that makes daily living effortless. Set in a quiet, well-maintained community, this home puts everything you need within easy reach. Grab dinner at one of the many nearby restaurants, pick up essentials at Walmart, or visit the brand-new brewery just down the street. Fitness centers, medical offices, and grocery stores are all minutes away, and for a dose of nature, Cranbury Park's walking trails and open green space are right nearby. With quick access to the Merritt Parkway, commuting around Fairfield County is a breeze. Experience a lifestyle where convenience meets comfort, all you have to do is move in and enjoy. Excellent credit and income required, no pets, no smoking.
